hyperedges.label: Editors preserve originals and retain only an in-memory editing session
Recorded checks distinguish completed evidence from untested acceptance
Generated fixtures support private media verification
Archive integrity, bounded parsing and staging precede publication
Hardware and durable-save acknowledgments gate visible camera state

nodes.label: Optimized timing and regression limits
nodes.description: 120 debug tests and optimized builds pass; optimized runner reaches test but stops at keyguard before measurements. Owner requested stop. No completed optimized timing, quantified gain, 60 FPS guarantee or full R8 regression suite claimed.

nodes.label: 120 tests and Pixel gallery/slider checks
nodes.description: 120 tests pass; generated red-to-blue delayed preview continuity, 96-item reentries/selection, Settings/Lock order and hardware zoom at 4K60 pass. No usable screenshot, CMF install or fresh two-phone slider test claimed.

nodes.label: Acknowledged controls and stable media identity
nodes.description: Camera readout follows hardware state; loading/error/empty states explicit; stable media/request identity and previous-image placeholder preserve continuity.
nodes.norm_label: acknowledged controls and stable media identity
nodes.rationale: UI should reflect applied camera state and retain recognizable media across asynchronous refresh.

nodes.label: Explicit album loading and Retry state
nodes.description: Implemented separate loading/error/confirmed-empty state; sorting retains visible media during replacement query; failed query offers Retry.
nodes.norm_label: explicit album loading and retry state
nodes.rationale: Opening albums previously cleared list before first database emission and falsely displayed an empty album.

nodes.label: Acknowledged bounded hardware zoom
nodes.description: Implemented; ratio follows camera acknowledgment, allows reported minimum below 1x, conflates pending targets and resets on lens changes. Zoom remains available while recording.
nodes.rationale: Conflation bounds gesture traffic; acknowledged state avoids presenting an unapplied target as hardware state.

nodes.label: Shared acknowledged vertical camera zoom slider
nodes.description: Local/viewer right-side slider reuses bounded conflated queues and pinch; enabled only after selected lens initial zoom applies.
nodes.norm_label: shared acknowledged vertical camera zoom slider
nodes.rationale: Pixel device test found binding enabled controls before initial lens zoom completed; appliedCameraId readiness guard resolved race.

nodes.label: Retained encrypted preview during upgrades
nodes.description: Media and album requests reuse cached prior preview, disable crossfade, request 512 pixels and honor bounded decode dimensions; stable item IDs remain.
nodes.rationale: Encrypted thumbnail-path replacement previously started a new request with no retained placeholder, producing blank/flickering previews.

nodes.label: Gallery loading and camera slider gate
nodes.description: Scoped PASS: Pixel verifies vertical slider bounds, accessible Set Progress, disabled rejection and Home order; 90% dark scrim and 48 dp target. No usable screenshot, landscape/large-font/keyboard or fresh two-phone checks.
nodes.norm_label: gallery loading and camera slider gate

nodes.label: Gallery stability and camera zoom slider
nodes.norm_label: gallery stability and camera zoom slider

nodes.label: 117 tests and bidirectional interaction evidence
nodes.description: 117 unit tests pass; real two-finger gestures, focus, microphone OFF/ON/OFF, recording guards and silent encrypted saves pass on CMF and Pixel. CMF 1080p clip measured 59.4419 FPS; Pixel 4K clip 60.0166 FPS.

nodes.label: Camera gesture and microphone UI gate
nodes.description: Document reports scoped PASS with dark/mint controls, ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION 1/1/1, 48 dp microphone target, named zoom actions and 90% dark scrims. Other screens not recertified.
nodes.norm_label: camera gesture and microphone ui gate

nodes.label: Final microphone refinement verification limit
nodes.description: Final disabled tint/unavailable-recording guard rebuilt, unit-tested and installed on both phones; full live suite not repeated. Audio-on clip metadata, every lens, landscape, keyboard and large fonts untested.

nodes.label: Visible-image tap-to-focus mapping
nodes.description: Implemented; accounts for crop, rotation, fit and encoder letterboxing, rejects black margins and overlays. Completion acknowledges metering rather than optical sharpness.

nodes.label: Idle-only synchronized microphone selection
nodes.description: Implemented; existing audio permission required, no remote permission prompt, blocked during recording and saving.
nodes.rationale: Avoid altering audio tracks or rebinding cameras mid-recording.

nodes.label: Camera UI gate coverage limits
nodes.description: Lint remains 41 errors/115 warnings; landscape, large fonts, physical keyboard, all lenses and audio-on metadata not claimed. Final UI refinement did not repeat the full live suite.

nodes.label: Over-image camera control contrast
nodes.description: Reported contrast over white imagery: primary text 13.77:1, mint 5.68:1, muted icon 4.94:1. Image-hidden viewer screenshot inspected.

nodes.label: 143 tests and both-phone generated editor checks
nodes.description: 143 tests/build and full generated-media runs pass CMF/Pixel; picker filename semantics fixed for absent thumbnails, final APK both installed. Export still saves new video inside vault.
nodes.norm_label: 143 tests and both-phone generated editor checks

nodes.label: Flexible preview and bounded fallback workspace
nodes.description: 48dp icons/64dp tools, fixed spacing/type scales; short height or large text uses scrollable workspace and bounded preview; tall sticker stacks bounded independently.
nodes.norm_label: flexible preview and bounded fallback workspace
nodes.rationale: Track stacks and compact windows must not consume the video focal area.

nodes.label: Compact viewer portrait screenshot and contrast gate
nodes.description: Actual Pixel and CMF image-hidden screenshots inspected; white Record text corrected to dark content colour. Contrast dark/mint7.39:1, primary/dark17.91:1; no physical responsive/keyboard certification.
nodes.norm_label: compact viewer portrait screenshot and contrast gate

nodes.label: Approved fixed-playhead editing timeline
nodes.description: Existing tools/dark-mint retained; Save renamed Export with same vault destination, ruler/fixed centre playhead, horizontal scrubbing/pinch, fixed Add, clip-travelling Mute and sticker lanes.

nodes.label: Persistent Disconnect outside scrolling controls
nodes.description: Quality/flash controls scroll; Disconnect remains outside; pre-pairing unavailable controls hidden. Real device failures exposing buried recovery and crowded wrong-PIN errors were fixed and retested.
nodes.rationale: Keep exit and error recovery reachable while preserving preview space.

nodes.label: Approved editor and picker UI delivery gate
nodes.description: Scoped PASS for user references, dark/mint1/1/1; generated-media device checks cover real gestures, Add/Mute, history, tools, picker, recovery, Export/cancel. Screenshots inspected at both phone widths.
nodes.norm_label: approved editor and picker ui delivery gate

nodes.label: Remote camera scoped delivery gate chronology
nodes.norm_label: remote camera scoped delivery gate chronology

nodes.label: Remote quality, flash and encrypted-save evidence
nodes.description: 98 tests and both phone roles pass; Pixel default 4K60 and CMF 4K30; selected 1080p60 measured about 59.44/59.74 FPS. Flash before/during recording and CMF native background save pass. All listed clips silent with portrait rotation.
nodes.norm_label: remote quality, flash and encrypted-save evidence

nodes.label: Reference-based compact viewer layout
nodes.description: Centered device title/larger preview, in-preview menus, Record/Disconnect below, transient routine confirmations, persistent errors/time/save progress. Source reflow below320dp or above1.3 font scale; broader physical layout checks remain limited.

nodes.label: Camera menu scoped delivery gate
nodes.description: Document reports native menu 48 dp checks on both phones, dark/mint1/1/1, selector readiness/acknowledged state, no private-frame screenshots. Physical field of view/mirroring/landscape/large text/keyboard not established.

nodes.label: Advertised camera/lens selection
nodes.description: Implemented available camera catalog, bounded advertised IDs, readiness plus applied-zoom acknowledgment, local-to-viewer sync and one pending sequential command.
nodes.rationale: Avoid hardcoded device roles/lenses and falsely acknowledging fallback or unready selections.

nodes.label: Highest supported saved quality and remote flash
nodes.description: Implemented resolution-before-FPS quality ranking, 720p30 transport independent of saved mode, idle-only quality, flash while recording, 60 FPS photo unavailable. Pixel4K60/CMF4K30 and both1080p60 verified; 98 tests pass.
nodes.norm_label: highest supported saved quality and remote flash

nodes.label: Remote recording acknowledgment and encrypted save
nodes.description: Implemented start after CameraX Start and stop after Finalize/encryption/thumbnail/database save; disconnect/background/navigation stop recording. Photo/lens blocked during recording/save.
nodes.norm_label: remote recording acknowledgment and encrypted save
nodes.rationale: A tap or queue-idle state does not establish that capture or durable save succeeded.

nodes.label: Reverted thumbnail performance experiments
nodes.description: Concurrent decoders, tile-width decoding and delayed legacy upgrades were reverted because trial medians did not reliably improve over noisy baselines.

nodes.label: Generated-media test privacy and restoration
nodes.description: Only generated colour-bar video/emoji visible in screenshots; test restores secure flag/preferences/prior draft and deletes owned media.
nodes.rationale: Enable reviewable visual evidence without exposing personal vault content or disturbing the owner's editing state.

nodes.label: Retained nondebuggable R8 performance build
nodes.description: Optional performance variant retained on owner's subjective smoother-scrolling report; uses existing debug signing certificate for data-preserving update. Scoped instrumentation keep rules retain shared runtime APIs.
nodes.rationale: Compose performance should be evaluated without debugging and with R8; source decoder/UI experiments were not retained.

nodes.label: Generated encrypted gallery frame benchmark
nodes.description: Pixel 5 benchmark uses 96 generated items, fresh IDs/Coil caches, three trials with Window FrameMetrics p95. over16msPct is a fixed threshold metric rather than Android full jank.
nodes.rationale: Private media is filtered out; fixtures removed; separate phase percentiles cannot be summed and warm-up/load variance limits inference.

nodes.label: Final semantics refinement and input limits
nodes.description: Unit suite ran before final picker semantics-only fix; final build/device checks both pass. Short-height/large-text fallback inspected in source; physical keyboard and extreme font-size checks not performed.
nodes.norm_label: final semantics refinement and input limits

nodes.label: Pixel mosaic with prohibition symbol
nodes.description: First frame only: a grayscale block mosaic inside a circle, overlaid with a thick red-orange prohibition ring and diagonal slash, with vivid green outside the circle. Animation and app behavior were not inspected or inferred.

nodes.norm_label: orange cross section with white pith and seeds

nodes.label: Cream thread crossed through four button holes
nodes.norm_label: cream thread crossed through four button holes

nodes.description: Visible blocks form a coarse square grid in black, white, and intermediate gray shades.

nodes.label: Grid pixel 02 sticker image
nodes.description: First-frame-only visual inspection: a large circle composed of irregular grayscale square and rectangular blocks, with fine streaked textures, against a vivid green surround. Animation and later frames were not inspected.

nodes.label: Circular boundary and green surround
nodes.description: The grayscale mosaic occupies a large circular region; vivid green fills the exterior corners in the inspected frame.

nodes.label: Grayscale block mosaic
nodes.description: Visible square and rectangular patches range from near black through gray to near white, with fine linear textures.

nodes.label: Grayscale pixel mosaic
nodes.description: Large gray, white, and black square blocks form the central background.

nodes.label: CENSORED pixel mosaic sticker
nodes.description: Single displayed GIF frame: grayscale square mosaic with a diagonal black brushstroke carrying bold white CENSORED text, bright green vertical side strips, and black outer margins.
nodes.inspection_limitation: First-frame-only visual inspection; animation and later frames were not inspected.

nodes.label: Diagonal CENSORED brushstroke banner
nodes.description: White uppercase CENSORED text lies on a rough black stroke rising from lower left to upper right.

nodes.label: 18+ symbol centered on a pale rounded square
nodes.norm_label: 18+ symbol centered on a pale rounded square

nodes.label: Monochrome block grid with fine glitch-like line texture
nodes.norm_label: monochrome block grid with fine glitch-like line texture

nodes.label: Grayscale pixel mosaic heart sticker
nodes.description: First frame only: a large heart silhouette filled with gray, white, and black rectangular mosaic blocks against bright green, with black outer margins. Later animation frames were not inspected.

nodes.label: Grayscale question mark sticker
nodes.description: Visually inspected first frame only: a large white question mark centered on a circular grayscale pixel mosaic against black surrounding space. Animation and later frames were not inspected.

nodes.label: Grayscale rectangular pixel grid
nodes.description: Abstract square image formed from irregular black, white, and gray rectangular bands arranged in horizontal rows; several bands show fine stippled texture.
nodes.inspection_limitation: First frame only; animation and application behavior were not inspected.

nodes.label: AGSL video look preview after Media3 effect failures
nodes.description: Android 13+ RuntimeShader RenderEffect samples LUT; export applies LUT after Presentation and before framing.
nodes.norm_label: agsl video look preview after media3 effect failures
nodes.rationale: Media3 effect sink initialization and clipped-playlist black-view failures led to abandoning player.setVideoEffects for preview.

nodes.label: Temporary export plaintext boundary
nodes.description: Encrypted input read directly; only Transformer output cache file is plaintext, removed in finally and on next start.

nodes.label: Photo filter/adjust/grain pipeline
nodes.description: Filter strength precedes ten shared colour adjustments and seeded grain; drawing follows geometry and colour processing.

nodes.label: Photo crop/rotate/flip/straighten geometry
nodes.description: Free and fixed aspect ratios; straighten ±30 degrees avoids empty corners; strokes retain photo coordinates.

nodes.label: Per-clip framing and colour adjustments
nodes.description: Free rotation with quarter-turn snap, zoom and offsets; ten per-clip adjustments represented as 33-cubed LUT, copyable to all clips.

nodes.label: Session-only vault video project
nodes.description: Home Video editor adds vault videos only; per-video Edit remains unchanged; source clips preserved and no saved drafts.

nodes.label: CMF multi-clip owner evidence
nodes.description: Joining, timeline and stickers confirmed; spec still says transparent PNG pending while later changelog records PNG confirmation.

nodes.label: CPU save with Android 13+ AGSL preview
nodes.description: Later progress supersedes initial CPU-only preview: live colour/filter/grain shader and CPU geometry/blur drawing; encrypted in-memory JPEG save quality 95, max long side 6000 px.
nodes.norm_label: cpu save with android 13+ agsl preview

nodes.label: In-memory photo edit across vault lock
nodes.description: Lock keeps edit in memory; unlock returns; leaving changes requires discard confirmation.
nodes.norm_label: in-memory photo edit across vault lock

nodes.label: Fixed-playhead scrolling video timeline
nodes.description: Per-clip thumbnails, pinch zoom, scrubbing and edge trim; swipe has no fling in this spec.

nodes.label: Sticker placement keyframes
nodes.description: Placement angle/size/position interpolates linearly; editing beyond 150 ms creates or updates keys and auto-creates an initial placement key.

nodes.label: Photo brush, blur and mosaic
nodes.description: Size, softness, colour, strength, undo, brush-size circle and pinch zoom.

nodes.label: Immutable clip edits and range limits
nodes.description: Split, trim, reorder, delete and mute; minimum clip 0.5 seconds; sticker ranges clamp after clip changes.
nodes.norm_label: immutable clip edits and range limits

nodes.label: Emoji and vault-photo sticker overlays
nodes.description: Up to ten stickers with time ranges; photos decrypted only in memory capped at 1024 px, preserving PNG transparency.

nodes.label: Shared Media3 export pipeline
nodes.description: VideoEditManager handles old and new editors; composition sequence fits first upright clip shape, forces audio track, overlays stickers and saves Edit_<date> in first album.

nodes.label: Video draft retained through vault lock
nodes.description: VideoEditManager.draft holds project/playhead in memory; hidden app pauses playback and keep-open camera shortcut yields to active draft.
nodes.norm_label: video draft retained through vault lock

nodes.label: Photo editor saves encrypted copies
nodes.description: Viewer Edit opens Adjust, Crop, Filters and Draw; new incremented _edited copy in same album preserves original.

nodes.label: Transfer validation and remaining matrix
nodes.description: 128-test suite and generated-media CMF to Pixel no-PIN, reverse PIN, decline and both-side cancellation checks pass; large transfer, cooldown, timeout, low storage and speed matrix remain.

nodes.label: Editor and transfer validation limits
nodes.description: 158 combined editor tests pass; CMF owner checks cover core editor behavior; animated GIFs, some face/sticker controls and photo lock recovery remain unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Streaming quality and latency targets
nodes.description: 720p30, first frame within 5 seconds, five-minute sustained viewing and median visual delay under 500 ms.

nodes.label: Manifest validation and display-only filenames
nodes.description: At most 10000 albums and 100000 items; safe sizes, unique IDs/names and valid cover relations; never interpret originalFilename as filesystem path.

nodes.label: Wi-Fi NSD and optional BLE assistance
nodes.description: BLE provides discovery/setup metadata; media stays on Wi-Fi, and denied Bluetooth must preserve Wi-Fi discovery.
nodes.norm_label: wi-fi nsd and optional ble assistance

nodes.label: SVF1 transfer protocol
nodes.description: Big-endian validated offer/item framing; at most 500 items, 1 TiB total, 16 GiB per item, exact byte count and SHA-256 per item, final SVFE acknowledgement.

nodes.label: Two-phone pairing and five-minute stream evidence
nodes.description: Both role directions pass pairing/live-view checks; five-minute CMF to Pixel PIN stream passed; R1–R14 retain remaining acceptance gaps.
nodes.norm_label: two-phone pairing and five-minute stream evidence

nodes.label: Certificate-bound J-PAKE streaming authentication
nodes.description: Bouncy Castle 1.86 lightweight J-PAKE supplies mutual PIN confirmation bound to native TLS identity; discovery exposes no pairing secret.

nodes.label: Albums, covers, gallery and private playback
nodes.description: Camera/Imports system albums, custom albums and covers, move without encrypted-file duplication, sort, multi-select and swipe viewer.
nodes.norm_label: albums, covers, gallery and private playback

nodes.label: Camera capture and device-specific modes
nodes.description: CameraX standard modes and CMF Camera2 high-FPS path; this snapshot lists 4K30 default and pending Pixel/CMF verification, superseded in some later changelog entries.

nodes.label: Bounded sender decrypt-to-TLS pipeline
nodes.description: Decrypt vault data into socket with hash and progress; wait for item save acknowledgements.

nodes.label: Normal-camera Wi-Fi streaming
nodes.description: Either phone can send or view; camera Stream and Home View stream entries replace manual connection entry.

nodes.label: Backup-password PBKDF2 contract
nodes.description: Exact untrimmed, unnormalized UTF-8 password, 600000 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 iterations, 16-byte salt and 256-bit key independent of vault/device secrets.

nodes.label: Kotlin read/import-only scope
nodes.description: Exact version-1 format only; no new writer, format changes, destination-encryption replacement or unlock-policy changes.

nodes.label: Authenticated final summary and strict EOF
nodes.description: Final counts and total plaintext bytes must match manifest and consumption; missing final record or trailing bytes reject archive.
nodes.norm_label: authenticated final summary and strict eof

nodes.label: Attempt-owned staging and durable publication
nodes.description: Final summary and EOF pass before visibility; destination re-encryption, cancellation cleanup and journaled process-death recovery preserve existing vault.

nodes.label: Separate persistent encrypted streaming PIN
nodes.description: Four-digit sender PIN uses its own Keystore key; viewer PIN is not saved; five failures trigger 30-second sender-wide cooldown.

nodes.label: Cross-app malformed-input and recovery matrix
nodes.description: Golden Node and production APK synthetic archives, zero/chunk boundary media, tamper/truncation/EOF errors, SAF failures, low disk, duplicates and process kill around commit.

nodes.label: Receiver merge policy requires inventory
nodes.description: Handoff asks to inventory target policy and decide merge/separate destination; export interoperability spec supplies SecretVault merge reference semantics rather than proving receiver behavior.

nodes.label: Encrypted preview processing supersedes plaintext staging
nodes.description: Initial spec allowed temporary video metadata plaintext; later progress states encrypted random access without plaintext staging.
nodes.norm_label: encrypted preview processing supersedes plaintext staging

nodes.label: Initial streaming scope excludes remote capture/audio
nodes.description: Initial test limits foreground live video and excludes remote shutter, microphone and recording; later changelog documents expanded remote control.
nodes.norm_label: initial streaming scope excludes remote capture/audio

nodes.label: Bounded untrusted SAF stream parser
nodes.description: InputStream readFully/EOF, checked unsigned fields, authenticated single-record processing, no whole-archive buffering or reliance on available().

nodes.label: Share-specific pairing purpose
nodes.description: J-PAKE SHARE purpose uses SV-share-v1 and sender/receiver roles to separate camera authorization.

nodes.label: Local ciphertext versus archive plaintext size
nodes.description: Local 21-byte header, 64 KiB chunks and 20-byte overhead permit O(1) plaintext-size calculation; database on-disk size must not become manifest plaintext size.
nodes.norm_label: local ciphertext versus archive plaintext size

nodes.label: 1.1.1 optimized streaming release
nodes.description: Local camera streaming, optional Bluetooth discovery assistance, remote capture/recording controls and optional four-digit PIN.

nodes.label: Explicit stream shutdown and restart
nodes.description: Lock, background, leaving, Stop or Disconnect release resources; network loss cannot display stale frames as live.

nodes.label: Encrypted receiver pipeline to Imports
nodes.description: New app-owned IDs, streaming encryption, hash verification, encrypted preview generation and metadata insertion; archive-supplied name is display metadata.

nodes.label: Per-video encrypted trim/remove editing
nodes.description: New encrypted edited copies preserve originals; Media3 fast-trim metadata probe disabled for encrypted input.

nodes.label: Narrow SAF picker and transient password import flow
nodes.description: No broad storage permission; cancellable staged progress, preserve password spaces and existing vault-lock policy; no persistent derived key.
nodes.norm_label: narrow saf picker and transient password import flow

nodes.label: Keep completed items and discard partial transfer
nodes.description: No resume; cancellation closes socket and removes current partial item. Lock, background or leaving cancels and stops advertising.
nodes.norm_label: keep completed items and discard partial transfer

nodes.label: Sequential record nonce and AAD tag chain
nodes.description: Nonce is eight zero bytes plus UInt32BE index; 57-byte AAD combines file header, record header and previous tag; exact incrementing sequence.
nodes.norm_label: sequential record nonce and aad tag chain

nodes.label: Exact UTF-8 KDF interoperability vectors
nodes.description: Nonempty password ≤1024 UTF-8 bytes without trim/normalization; prove PBEKeySpec provider compatibility using ASCII, spaces, non-Latin, emoji and normalization-distinct vectors.

nodes.label: Same-Wi-Fi photo/video sharing
nodes.description: One sender and receiver per session; hotspot counts; no cloud, Bluetooth data transfer or protocol negotiation beyond version byte.

nodes.label: Recording pause/resume
nodes.description: Paused time is excluded from saved duration for local or remotely controlled recordings.

nodes.label: Unreleased: photo and multi-clip video editors
nodes.description: Photo saves a new copy; multi-clip output uses the first clip shape, stickers and tracked face covers.
nodes.norm_label: unreleased: photo and multi-clip video editors

nodes.label: Non-destructive photo and video editing
nodes.description: Photo viewer editor and Home multi-clip editor preserve originals; detailed snapshot includes GIF stickers and tracked face blur, no saved drafts.

nodes.label: Restore merge and byte-content duplicates
nodes.description: Preserve existing content; albums match ID+kind then trimmed case-insensitive name; dedupe full plaintext fingerprint+type+size, fresh destination IDs, preserve existing covers.

nodes.label: Single camera owner and matched preview geometry
nodes.description: Preview and streaming share lens, zoom, crop, orientation and mirroring; no competing camera session.
nodes.norm_label: single camera owner and matched preview geometry

nodes.label: Cross-app restore acceptance evidence requirements
nodes.description: Production archives, Unicode/space password vectors, real encrypted playback and interrupted-publication tests required; not a claim all have passed.

nodes.label: Keystore-protected SQLCipher and authenticated media completion
nodes.description: Random database key, fail closed when Keystore unavailable and authenticate encrypted media completion.
nodes.norm_label: keystore-protected sqlcipher and authenticated media completion

nodes.label: Chunked AES-256-GCM media with wrapped per-file keys
nodes.description: Random new file key wrapped by Android Keystore; in-use keys in memory; version-1 media remains readable without automatic migration.
nodes.norm_label: chunked aes-256-gcm media with wrapped per-file keys

nodes.label: Per-transfer receiver acceptance
nodes.description: Receiver explicitly accepts each offer; unanswered offers decline after 60 seconds.

nodes.label: Version-1 album/item manifest
nodes.description: Record 0 encrypted UTF-8 JSON max 16 MiB; ordered media item sizes are exact plaintext bytes; same-album photo cover references.

nodes.label: Referenced production writer and independent format oracle
nodes.description: References TypeScript writer/manifest/restore, Node format.mjs vectors and Android synthetic crypto self-test; self-test is not production importer.
nodes.norm_label: referenced production writer and independent format oracle

nodes.label: Unreleased: direct SV file transfers
nodes.description: Same-Wi-Fi photo/video transfer with explicit Accept/Decline, optional streaming-PIN pairing and Imports destination.

nodes.label: Optional sharing PIN and remembered receivers
nodes.description: Sharing PIN off by default; Require PIN is separate from camera setting and reuses streaming PIN. Up to ten previous receiver names, no saved secrets.
nodes.norm_label: optional sharing pin and remembered receivers

nodes.label: SVBACK01 encrypted backup container
nodes.description: Streamable album/photo/video metadata and bytes; 32-byte header, 256 KiB media chunks and framed AES-256-GCM records.

nodes.label: Android sharing and encrypted svtransfer package
nodes.description: Temporary decrypted Android sharing copies plus one-time QR-derived svtransfer package; direct Wi-Fi sharing is documented separately in newer changelog.
nodes.norm_label: android sharing and encrypted svtransfer package

nodes.label: Staged re-encryption and all-or-nothing publication
nodes.description: Validate complete archive before publishing; re-encrypt with destination vault scheme, verify content fingerprint and journal or transactionally publish attempt-owned files.

nodes.label: Validated manifest and destination model mapping
nodes.description: Validate cover/album/count/date/size relationships and generate destination-owned paths/IDs; follow receiver duplicate/product policies.
nodes.norm_label: validated manifest and destination model mapping

nodes.label: Weather Today offline Android vault
nodes.description: Weather decoy, PIN and optional biometric access, app-private photos/videos; no account, cloud, backend, analytics or live weather.

nodes.label: SVBACK01 export architecture and interoperability specification
nodes.norm_label: svback01 export architecture and interoperability specification

nodes.label: Outstanding stream acceptance evidence
nodes.description: 20 external visual-delay samples/500 ms median target, internet-disabled Wi-Fi, client isolation, live permission/Wi-Fi loss, full process/surface races, landscape/large text/keyboard and unrelated sharing/backup/playback regressions remain unverified.

nodes.label: Five-minute CMF-to-Pixel stream evidence
nodes.description: 300-second sender/305-second viewer checks pass, minimum sampled encoded/rendered FPS 25/26, no stall/reconnect/queue failure; portrait image confirmed by user. Ordinary CMF recording after Stop measured 59.4 FPS.

nodes.label: Measured TextureView startup rotation race
nodes.description: Actual-view regression found identity transform when configuration preceded layout. fitPreview defers fitting with doOnLayout; fails before fix and passes after in production and diagnostic viewers.
nodes.rationale: Generated-chart geometry tests manually rotated their bitmap and did not establish production on-screen orientation.

nodes.label: Shared camera GPU stream integration
nodes.description: CameraManager or existing CMF vendor session remains sole camera owner; EGL/GLES renderer supplies local preview and 720p30 encoder. Generated chart caught and verified GL rotation correction.
nodes.rationale: Avoid a second camera acquisition, screenshot copying and unproved vendor output combinations.

nodes.label: Capture-free prototype capability evidence
nodes.description: Historical probes and generated H.264 fixture/TLS checks pass; 90-test baseline. Capability/configuration evidence alone does not establish live capture.

nodes.label: Original live failure remains unconfirmed
nodes.description: Live UI checks pass both role directions after test synchronization corrections; original user-reported failure was not reproduced and no root cause is claimed.

nodes.label: Revised R1–R14 streaming plan
nodes.description: Plan updated 2026-10-02; camera/home integration, separate PIN, PAKE, NSD/BLE reported implemented with two roles and five-minute evidence. Historical prototype retained; unchecked acceptance remains pending.

nodes.label: Pending full stream lifecycle acceptance
nodes.description: R13 unchecked: lock/background/surface/Wi-Fi/permission loss, slow peer/overflow, repeated lifecycle and replay/resource checks across media/discovery/pairing. Source review or limited disconnect checks do not satisfy every case.

nodes.label: Pending full performance and regression acceptance
nodes.description: R14 unchecked: complete actual-coded/FPS/discovery/first-frame report,20 visual-delay samples, five-minute and post-stream regression/complete scoped gates. Historical unchecked tasks are not current passed evidence.
nodes.norm_label: pending full performance and regression acceptance

nodes.label: Revised R1–R14 backlog with partial acceptance
nodes.description: R2/R3/R4/R6/R7/R8/R9/R10/R11/R12 implementation boxes completed with mixed unchecked acceptance; R1 original cause, R5 geometry, R13 lifecycle and R14 complete measurement remain open. Later checkpoints record remote controls/quality/layout passes.
nodes.norm_label: revised r1–r14 backlog with partial acceptance

nodes.label: Pending lens, mirror and orientation acceptance
nodes.description: R5 real-image asymmetric lens/mirroring/landscape verification pending; portrait confirmed upright and source rebind resumes delivery but counters dipped to2FPS during transitions.
nodes.norm_label: pending lens, mirror and orientation acceptance

nodes.label: Compact viewer portrait validation
nodes.description: Reference-based layout built/installed both phones; actual Pixel screenshot with imagery hidden inspected, reverse-role photo/lens controls pass. Width mutation stayed green, exposing missing unit reflow coverage.

nodes.label: 107 tests and CMF gallery device checks
nodes.description: 107 tests pass; CMF verifies real gestures, zoomed video playback, rotation, Favorites navigation and encrypted upgrades. Generated circle stays round, originals unchanged. Installed both phones; Pixel live test awaits unlock.
nodes.norm_label: 107 tests and cmf gallery device checks

nodes.label: Bidirectional generated transfer checks
nodes.description: 128 tests/build pass; 20 JPEGs and one 32 MiB padded video verified in each direction with PIN off/on. Decline/cancel preserve completed items; required-PIN and preview-cancel regressions pass. Final UUID/preview cleanup reruns cover success only.

nodes.label: Bounded viewer zoom and pager guard
nodes.description: Implemented 1–5x pinch/double-tap, fitted-content pan, orientation/page reset and accessible zoom actions; pager swipes blocked while enlarged.
nodes.norm_label: bounded viewer zoom and pager guard
nodes.rationale: Preserve media inspection and playback while avoiding accidental page changes.

nodes.label: Persisted Favorites collection
nodes.description: Implemented targeted existing isFavorite DAO update, viewer heart, badges and Home collection; failed writes preserve state; no database migration. Existing backup v1 manifests omit favorite marks.

nodes.label: Random-access transfer and backup previews
nodes.description: Incoming video/backup previews use existing DecryptingMediaDataSource; full video plaintext temp and full photo-memory collection removed.
nodes.rationale: Bound preview memory and avoid new plaintext originals on disk.

nodes.label: PR3 cancellation-safe encrypted transfer
nodes.description: Missing required PIN preserves protected intent and Set PIN recovery; Cancel closes connecting sockets, removes unfinished encrypted data, preserves committed rows/counts, validates totals/final ACK and uses full UUIDs.
nodes.rationale: Prevent silent open receiving, orphaned files, data loss after committed insert or acknowledgment loss, and filename collision.

nodes.label: PR2 paused-state wire compatibility
nodes.description: PR2 merged 05092c17c585e9567a60538478fd8f06fe8eb635; paused flag requires both phones updated. 128 unit/mutation tests pass. Physical pause test supplied by owner, not repeated in this increment.

nodes.label: Gallery UI certification limits
nodes.description: Pixel live verification, physical keyboard, landscape and large fonts unclaimed; lint 41 errors/115 warnings. Favorites absent from backup v1, legacy previews refresh only visible/unlocked, small originals not upscaled.

nodes.label: Gallery gesture, Favorites and thumbnail gate
nodes.description: Scoped PASS reports CMF generated-fixture evidence, native dark/mint identity, 1/1/1 dials, 48 dp targets, named zoom accessibility and explicit empty/error/loading states.
nodes.norm_label: gallery gesture, favorites and thumbnail gate

nodes.label: Geometry-preserving encrypted thumbnail upgrades
nodes.description: Square center-crop decoded pixels at most 512 px, JPEG 90; camera/import/restore share policy. Visible older previews upgrade serially off-main via encrypted random access and thumbnail-only guarded update.
nodes.rationale: Fix squeezed portrait frames and sharper recognition without altering original media or decrypting whole videos to plaintext.

nodes.label: Transfer test scope limits
nodes.description: Tests use production engines in instrumented test process, not full normal screen navigation. 1 GiB video, accept timeout, low storage, Wi-Fi loss, sustained throughput and full R8 regressions unverified.

nodes.label: Recording pause and direct file sharing validation
nodes.norm_label: recording pause and direct file sharing validation

nodes.label: Protected pairing and dual discovery evidence
nodes.description: Bouncy Castle J-PAKE/TLS negative cases pass; pairing measured 529/553 ms; production PIN-to-first-frame 891/900 ms. BLE-only discovery and NSD/BLE deduplication pass both directions; timings are not visual delay.
nodes.norm_label: protected pairing and dual discovery evidence

nodes.label: Bounded hostile-input pairing and cooldown
nodes.description: Canonical bounded integers/IDs and fixed counts, five-second TLS connect/read, fifteen-second watchdog, one pairing/viewer, five charged attempts then persisted30-second cooldown; aborted attempts charged.
nodes.rationale: Discovery and network input are hostile; bound memory/time/guessing and reject replay/reflection/downgrade before media.

nodes.label: Historical debug invitation prototype
nodes.description: Original architecture uses camera/encoder, bounded H.264 TLS, random-token manual invitation, debug-only Settings screen. Retained as history; new UX uses discovered camera and separate PIN.

nodes.label: Version-gated remote camera control messages
nodes.description: Photo types3–5, selection6–8/v4–5, recording9–11/v6–7, quality-flash12–14/v8–9; newer endpoints hidden from older parsers, updated viewers retain older-camera support. Foreground unlocked camera ownership gates operations.

nodes.label: Single ordered sequential remote-command slot
nodes.description: Photo/selection/video/settings commands share increasing positive64-bit IDs, one pending slot and one writer with frames; bounded deadlines, no automatic retry.
nodes.rationale: Prevent overlapping/replayed commands and message interleaving; timeouts may leave late applied hardware/save outcomes requiring local inspection.

nodes.label: Certificate-bound four-digit J-PAKE pairing
nodes.description: Pinned bcprov-jdk18on1.86 lightweight JPAKEParticipant NIST3072/SHA256; four ASCII digits, fresh participant/nonces, role/session/TLS-certificate binding, validated rounds1–3 mutual confirmation then ACK. Native TLS encrypts media; no provider replacement.

nodes.label: Untrusted discovery with certificate-bound PAKE
nodes.description: Plan requires bounded public NSD/BLE metadata, reviewed PAKE mutual confirmation bound to actual TLS certificate/session/roles, isolated encrypted PIN storage and persisted retry limits.
nodes.rationale: Low-entropy PIN plus an unauthenticated discovery fingerprint cannot authenticate identity; reusable digests permit offline guessing.

nodes.label: Single-owner GPU camera integration
nodes.description: Planned architecture decouples Surface-input encoder, shares CameraX/CMF active preview through EGL, retains fixed codec format and requests fresh keyframes on rebind.
nodes.rationale: Avoid second camera ownership, screenshot copies and codec resets where format is unchanged; device output combinations require proof.

nodes.label: Optional PIN open stream session binding
nodes.description: Protected defaultv2 and openv3 use distinct magic; open uses pinned TLS plus exact session ID and ACK, authenticates no viewer. Anyone on local Wi-Fi may view/control active open stream; protected listener rejects downgrade.
nodes.norm_label: optional pin open stream session binding

nodes.label: Stream targets and honest measurement
nodes.description: Targets: 720p30, about 3 Mbps, first frame within five seconds, five minutes viewing, median visual delay below 500 ms. External 20-sample visual measurement required; targets are not automatic passed checks.

nodes.label: Local camera pairing and control protocol
nodes.norm_label: local camera pairing and control protocol

nodes.label: 149 editor-era tests with one existing failure
nodes.description: 149 total,148 pass; existing CrossCompatibilityTest failure unrelated to editor. VideoProjectTest/FaceTracksTest cover clip transforms/history/keyframe curves/blur time mapping/tracking/face-sticker geometry.
nodes.norm_label: 149 editor-era tests with one existing failure

nodes.label: 158 tests and generated CMF integration evidence
nodes.description: 158 JVM tests, optimized/R8/vital-lint builds, CMF photo pixels, GIF loop/poster, missing-image export and timeline integration pass. Installed data-preserving APK on CMF; Pixel unavailable.
nodes.norm_label: 158 tests and generated cmf integration evidence

nodes.label: Editor integration hardware limits
nodes.description: Android12 CPU UI, very large photos, portrait/4K face scanning and successful exported GIF remain unverified. Same-source GIF preview timing shared; export instances independent. Keyboard/extreme text not repeated.

nodes.label: Editor hardware coverage exclusions
nodes.description: Android12-and-older preview CPU path, release R8 editor build and Pixel5 not covered in this status report. Later integration report has separate scoped R8/CMF evidence.

nodes.label: Preserved extracted timeline and grouped history
nodes.description: Conflict integration retains ruler/fixed playhead/fixed Add/scrolling Mute/pinch/sticker lanes; owning-clip region lanes join timeline, all edits including continuous Strength use existing history.
nodes.norm_label: preserved extracted timeline and grouped history

nodes.label: Unconfirmed editor device features
nodes.description: Keep-unlocked edit shortcut, separate moving-keyframe check, GIF preview/export, handles/duplicate, face stickers/head tilt, smoother curves/rescan exclusion/faster scan, portrait/4K and transformed-face export not confirmed.

nodes.label: Owner-confirmed CMF editor features
nodes.description: Owner tested separate com.secretvault.app.debug without replacing vault app: mixed-shape joins, timeline gestures, emoji saved output, edit survival across lock, framing, colour preview/export, PNG/WebP, manual blur and1080p tracking confirmed.

nodes.label: Photo transform, crop and stroke-order corrections
nodes.description: Quarter-turn flip axes/straighten corrected, crop minimums bounded at edges, hiding strokes use complete CPU renderer to match export order; generated Matrix/pixel tests cover regressions.
nodes.norm_label: photo transform, crop and stroke-order corrections

nodes.label: Face region coverage and missing-image export checks
nodes.description: Require complete rotated region coverage for rescan omission, cap previews by remaining 16-region slots, match face-sticker preview colour, fail export on missing image before saving.
nodes.norm_label: face region coverage and missing-image export checks
nodes.rationale: Avoid omitting uncovered faces, unbounded preview bitmap creation and silently dropping intended face stickers.

nodes.label: Bounded gesture-grouped project snapshot history
nodes.description: Up to100 in-memory snapshots including restored draft; each trim/sticker/slider gesture one entry; scrub/playback/zoom excluded, new edit clears redo, encrypted source unchanged.
nodes.rationale: Preserve user edit recovery without filling history with navigation or continuous gesture samples.
